messages:
oncall-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: SEV-2 - repeated NCCL communicator errors and CUDA OOM on dedicated pool dp-47 in us-west-2. Root thread_ts=1882349012
sarah: I'm on it. Seeing NCCL_TIMEOUT and CUDA OOM traces on gpu-node-21 and gpu-node-22 affecting tensor-parallel groups for model=redwood-3b-opt.
mike: Confirmed. stack traces show allreduce stalls then communicator resets. Sample log attached.
alex: log excerpt:
```
[2026-03-15T19:10:05Z] E NCCL: Async collision detected - peer timed out
[2026-03-15T19:10:06Z] E CUDA: out of memory while allocating 128MB
[2026-03-15T19:10:07Z] E Runtime: NCCL fatal error at /nccl/src/comm.c:comm_reset
```
sarah: hypothesis: sustained KV cache growth from long-context traffic + continuous cross-GPU batching causing memory pressure -> OOM -> NCCL communicator instability.
kevin: which customers impacted and is this Dedicated or Hosted?
julia: support note: only customers on dedicated pool dp-47 (region: aws-us-west-2) report elevated 5xx and timeouts. No PII leak. Internal ticket INC-4873 created.
mike: mitigation plan: (1) reduce cross-GPU batch parallelism; (2) force single-GPU fallbacks for affected routes; (3) cordon/drain nodes showing OOMs.
sarah: starting drain on gpu-node-21 now. Running commands:
```
kubectl cordon gpu-node-21
kubectl drain gpu-node-21 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force
redwoodctl nodes update --name gpu-node-21 --state=maintenance
```
infra-bot: gpu-node-21 cordoned by sarah at 19:11:02Z
sarah: cordon/evac moving containers to single-gpu hosts, expect brief 502/503s during handoff.
alex: pushing runtime toggle to disable continuous batching for model redwood-3b-opt on /v1/generate routes (canary 15%). PATCH payload:
```
PATCH /runtime/configs
{ "model":"redwood-3b-opt", "batching": { "continuous": false, "max_batch_size": 1 } }
```
mike: also preparing fallback policy to route to quantized variant redwood-3b-q8 when mem pressure detected (latency SLA check window 5m).
chris: is a full pod restart preferred over letting NCCL recover? We saw hung processes waiting on peers.
alex: when communicator resets mid-allreduce, workers often spin. A controlled pod restart reduces recovery time vs waiting for timeouts. We'll do rolling restarts on affected pods.
sarah: restart initiated on pod inference-3b-rt-a7 on gpu-node-22.
infra-bot: pod inference-3b-rt-a7 restarted by sarah at 19:14:40Z
mike: additionally toggled kv-cache eviction for heavy routes to per-request to limit growth:
```
redwoodctl runtime-config set --kv-eviction=per-request --routes="/v1/generate*"
```
julia: notifying customers on dp-47: "We're investigating degraded throughput on your dedicated capacity in us-west-2. We've begun routing to single-GPU fallbacks and are draining affected hosts. You may see brief 5xx responses while we stabilize." Sent under INC-4873.
kevin: any driver or NVLINK errors present?
alex: drivers up-to-date. NVLINK warnings sparse. Pattern matches memory-pressure + long-lived KV caches in pipeline parallel stages.
sarah: drain for gpu-node-21 complete; services migrated to single-GPU nodes. Error rate dropped significantly but gpu-node-22 still shows NCCL timeouts, draining there now.
mike: after restart+drain, dp-47 error rate reduced ~92%. Latency trending back to baseline. Monitoring closely for recurrence.
chris: short-term safeguards requested: (1) cap context length to 8192 tokens on dedicated pools; (2) disable cross-GPU continuous batching by default for heavy models; (3) add telemetry alert for repeated NCCL_COMM resets.
sarah: creating follow-up runbook task INC-4873-001 to implement kv-cache quotas and token caps; marking as high priority.
mike: also plan to run repro load with kv-eviction enabled and continuous-batching disabled to validate. Exploring NCCL env toggles (NCCL_ASYNC_ERROR_HANDLING=1) in a test cluster.
julia: scheduled customer follow-up in 45 minutes with incident summary and next steps.
sarah: uploading core dumps and dmesg from affected pods to s3://redwood-incidents/INC-4873/dumps for postmortem analysis.
infra-bot: upload complete at 19:28:10Z
sarah: handing monitoring to mike for overnight; I'll stay on-call until 20:00 PT to ensure stability. mike will take 20:00->08:00.
mike: taking over. Will draft postmortem and exec summary tomorrow AM.
julia: thanks team. Closing realtime incident channel; we'll continue edits in INC-4873 ticket for postmortem. :white_check_mark:
oncall-bot: Incident service levels normalized at 19:35:50Z. Last log note at 1882349150.
